name: interview-prep
description: Build role-specific interview preparation, run realistic practice, score performance, and record confirmed interview progress.
---

# Interview preparation

Start from the live tracker record, official posting, current stage, user profile,
and evidence inventory. Research the employer's current interview process from
official sources and label older or community reports accordingly.

Create a focused preparation plan covering only likely interview formats:

- Coding or practical repository work
- System or product design
- Data/platform depth
- Debugging and operational judgment
- Behavioral and values interviews
- Role-specific technologies or domain concepts

Run realistic timed practice instead of only providing study lists. Require the
candidate to state assumptions, explain tradeoffs, test edge cases, and evaluate
complexity. Score performance against an explicit rubric, identify concrete
defects, and assign targeted remediation.

Use only stories supported by `local/experience_inventory.md`. Help the user
prepare concise and detailed versions, but do not invent team size, business
impact, conflict, or leadership scope.

After the user confirms a scheduled interview or stage result, record it through
`outcome_record`. Do not infer progression from recruiter silence.
